info.name: Crowdbotics API Documentation admin pre_ingestion API

items.docs:
Start the pre-ingestion process for a specific repository. This process
will analyze the repository and return a summary of the supported files.

Args:
    request (PreIngestionRequest): The incoming request object.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.

Returns:
    PreIngestionResponse: Details about the initiated pre-ingestion process.

info.name: Upload repository files and run the pre-ingestion analysis

items.docs: Upload a single zipped repository file to Azure Blob Storage or Local directory,create a new project, and trigger pre-ingestion analysis.

info.name: Get a pre-signed URL for direct file upload

items.docs: Returns a time-limited pre-signed URL that allows the client to upload a file directly to storage, bypassing server-side proxying and Cloudflare's upload size limits.

info.name: Start pre-ingestion from an already-uploaded file

items.docs: Triggers the pre-ingestion analysis for a file that was uploaded directly to storage via a pre-signed URL obtained from the /upload-url endpoint.

Get the status of a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.

Returns:
    PreIngestionResponse: Details about the pre-ingestion job status.

Get the coverage results of a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.

Returns:
    PreIngestionCoverageResponse: Coverage details of the pre-ingestion job.

info.name: Get Excluded File Paths from Pre-Ingestion Job

items.docs:
Get the list of excluded file paths from a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.
    file_name (str, optional): Filter files by name.

Returns:
    list[str]: List of excluded file paths.

info.name: Get Included File Paths from Pre-Ingestion Job

items.docs:
Get the list of included file paths from a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.
    file_name (str, optional): Filter files by name.

Returns:
    list[str]: Paginated list of included file paths.

Update a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    application_context (str, optional): New application context.
    db (Session): The database session.

Returns:
    PreIngestionResponse: Updated details of the pre-ingestion job.

Delete a pre-ingestion job by its ID.

Args:
    job_id (int): The ID of the pre-ingestion job.
    user (ClerkUser): The authenticated user.
    organization (Organization): The organization context.
    db (Session): The database session.
    storage (StorageBackend): Storage backend for artifact cleanup.

Returns:
    dict: Confirmation message upon successful deletion.
